Great find near to our hotel.
May 2024 • Couples
Found this great Begian bar close to our hotel. Fantastic atmosphere as you walk in, we arrived at 9:30pm, the place was still busy but we were seated quickly and efficiently. Menu of both beers and good was extensive. We chose some of the Bapas (beer tapas) accompanied by a Belgian beer and a lovely red wine. 

Service was excellent and the staff very attentive. Food arrived quickly and was excellent quality. 

In summary, a great find and highly recommended.
